title: Rollin' Stepper
html: 1
js: const slider=root.querySelector('[role=slider]'),steps=Number(slider.dataset.steps||0);let value=0,drag=false;function set(next){value=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,next));if(steps)value=Math.round(value/100*(steps-1))/(steps-1)*100;slider.style.setProperty('--p',value/100);slider.style.setProperty('--roll',value*3.6+'deg');slider.style.setProperty('--hue',value*2.7+'deg');slider.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',String(steps?Math.round(value/100*(steps-1))+1:Math.round(value)));root.dataset.value=slider.getAttribute('aria-valuenow');const label=slider.querySelector('[data-digit]');if(label)label.textContent=root.dataset.value;}function move(event){const box=slider.getBoundingClientRect(),thumb=slider.querySelector('.thumb').getBoundingClientRect().width;set((event.clientX-box.left-thumb/2)/(box.width-thumb)*100)}slider.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{if(event.button!==0)return;drag=true;slider.dataset.dragging='true';slider.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);move(event);slider.focus({preventScroll:true})});slider.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{if(drag)move(event)});function end(){drag=false;slider.dataset.dragging='false'}slider.addEventListener('pointerup',end);slider.addEventListener('pointercancel',end);slider.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',end);slider.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{const step=steps?100/(steps-1):5;let next=value;if(event.key==='Home')next=0;else if(event.key==='End')next=100;else if(['ArrowRight','ArrowUp'].includes(event.key))next+=step;else if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowDown'].includes(event.key))next-=step;else if(event.key==='PageUp')next+=20;else if(event.key==='PageDown')next-=20;else return;event.preventDefault();set(next)});set(0);
prompt: Build a self-contained, accessible native HTML/CSS/JavaScript interpretation of Rollin' Stepper from https://drams.framer.website/drams/045. Credit DRAMS by 1042 Studio (@mrblackstudio and @karimeshrimp). An orange numbered ball rolls between three recessed stops, keeping the selected step in its centre. Use a white 320px stage, soft neutral contact shadows, subtle physical edge highlights and orange details. drag or click a stop; arrow keys move between the three steps. Preserve pointer and keyboard operation, reduced-motion support and the distinct geometry of this component. No hosted Framer embed or external runtime dependency.
